detail: picked "Not permitted, because it unfairly discriminates within one class"

N.J.S.A. 17B:30-12(c) bars unfair discrimination between individuals of the same class and equal expectation of life in rates charged. B shares the right conclusion but its reason (every applicant must pay an identical rate) is overbroad, since rates legitimately vary across classes, so a well-informed candidate would not defend it over D.
D's 'within one class' echoes the stem's 'same underwriting class', but that is a mild cue, and B also says 'Not permitted', so a candidate still has to know the rule to choose between them.
